description: This file is a shell script that provides functionality for rewriting the revision history in a Git repository. It includes functions for commit filtering, warning messages, and mechanisms to remap and filter commits, trees, tags, and references for history rewriting purposes.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Outputs warning messages to standard error.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Remaps commit identifiers based on a mapping file, defaults to echoing the original if no mapping exists.

methods.name: skip_commit
methods.description: Skips a commit by mapping its parent commits, effectively excluding the commit from history.

methods.name: git_commit_non_empty_tree
methods.description: Creates a commit only if the tree is not empty, or maps to an empty tree.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message to stderr and exits with status 1.

methods.name: finish_ident
methods.description: Completes setting Git author and committer identities based on parsed commit info.

methods.name: set_ident
methods.description: Parses author and committer info from a commit and finalizes the identities.
